column1: # Buildings no source draws.
# OpenStreetMap has never traced them and the campus tour predates them, so
# there is no outline to be had — only a position, and these were derived
# rather than guessed. The university's printed campus map keys every building
# to a label; fitting those label positions against the fifty buildings we
# already have coordinates for gives an affine transform good to about eight
# metres across thirty-one anchors, and these are what it puts the rest at.
# Where OSM has an untraced building in the right place, the pin was moved onto
# it: the Cedar Park pin sits on the apartments at Kirkmont Court, and the OPS
# pins sit in the university's service yard, both of which OSM draws but leaves
# unnamed. The four College View blocks share one pin because nothing on file
# tells them apart; they are one site about forty metres across.
# A pin is a point, not a footprint. Routing anchors to the walking-graph node
# nearest it, which is what an outline would have given anyway.
